changes: FinanceWorkbench and EcommerceAutomationWorkspace use one small useIndustryWorkflow lifecycle instead of independent running flags, result/status/error setters, abort refs and duplicated start/progress/catch/finally flows. Business-specific prompts, input validation and deterministic finance delivery remain separate.

A run acquires ownership synchronously before hashing or starting a task. Duplicate starts are ignored; cancellation works during preparation and creation, immediately releases the local running state and preserves any received task ID or partial output as interrupted. Old responses cannot launch execution, overwrite a newer result, or clear a newer running operation.

Workspace entry changes remount child drafts and cancel old requests; finance also keys by personal/work domain. The existing BusinessWorkbench parent still owns account, organization, role and subject boundaries. Streaming and deterministic finance completion are guarded by both mounted lifetime and current run identity.

Inputs are disabled while running in both workspaces. Explicit failure retains the entered brief or finance fields for retry; editing after completion resets obsolete task/error/output state together. Creation has a 30-second deadline; POST requests are never automatically replayed.

The workflow client accepts a start cancellation signal without serializing it into the body. Streamed execution cancels and releases its reader on completion, abort and failure, stops at the final event rather than waiting indefinitely for the HTTP connection to close, and ignores events after that final receipt. Missing final receipt still fails.

Finance runtime reads reuse apiJson for backend-origin and authentication handling, with a 15-second deadline. Deleted unused skill-state types, state and conversion from a contracts endpoint that does not return skills; removed an unreachable freeform JSON parser from structured finance form delivery. Malformed runtime metadata cannot be rendered as an object.
validationNotes: 14 focused files passed 172 tests, with zero failures/skips. Eight new behavior cases mount the actual commerce and finance components, shared hook, actual API transport and actual ReadableStream; only network responses are synthetic. React StrictMode, stop-before-create, obsolete start after restart, duplicate submission, stream cancellation on entry change, retry after denial, draft retention, credential propagation, deterministic tax/report input and evidence, late finance response after domain change, stop-before-hash, and explicit retry after creation timeout are exercised.

Existing frontend write-contract cases now also assert that a final event ends an otherwise open stream, reader locks are released, error events close the reader, and pre-aborted task creation does not make a network request. The existing missing-terminal, denied/malformed receipts and no-write-retry cases still pass.

An intermediate timeout UI assertion expected an exact message, while the DOMException was displayed with its error name; the assertion now accepts the message with that prefix and additionally verifies explicit retry. No failing or skipped cases remain in the final verification.

Related parent workbench, scope boundaries, legacy archives, REST receipts, ecommerce archive, finance delivery and commerce computations also passed using isolated test databases/files/local servers where needed. Lint including TypeScript/hooks/i18n, all-frontend build, desktop UI build and compact-layout check passed.

All final source fingerprints and earlier prune40-72 latest baselines matched; git diff whitespace verification passed. This is automated component/service/integration verification, not native-client or live-model acceptance.
limitations: Stopping a request does not roll back a task or finance artifact already accepted by the backend. The UI reports interruption and retains received evidence; it does not claim that persisted work was deleted. Creation timeout similarly does not prove the server failed to create a task.

Commerce/finance field drafts survive a failed request within the current mounted page, but navigation still unmounts them; full report editor restoration across navigation was not implemented. EcommerceHub file import, report/mapping/name state and diagnostic archive preparation are separate remaining candidates.

Finance runtime metadata failure shows attention; it does not acquire a new dedicated in-page retry control in this batch. The running stream has no new arbitrary overall execution timeout, and backend cancellation semantics/authorization/persistence are unchanged.

Business source decreases by 75 lines while regression tests add 89 lines; total source-plus-test count increases by 14. This is removal of duplicate business flow, not a claim of total line-count reduction.

No production records, providers, models, external services or user files were changed. No native desktop testing, full test-suite run, backend build, commit, push, deployment or restart was performed. Whole-project simplification remains incomplete.
remainingCandidates: EcommerceHub report data, names and field mappings are held in separate maps with repeated removal/reset paths; async file reads and archive writes need consistent ownership and navigation-draft review.
Other organization settings and the global confirmation dialog cancellation lifecycle still need their final project-wide pass.
